<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:background="@color/light_faded_orange" tools:context=".CustomerDashboard">
<TextView android:id="@+id/titleTextView" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="FOOD DASH" android:textSize="24sp" android:textStyle="bold" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" android:layout_marginTop="16dp" />
<ImageButton android:id="@+id/btnViewActiveOrders" android:layout_width="48dp" android:layout_height="48dp" android:layout_marginTop="8dp" android:layout_marginEnd="16dp" android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless" android:contentDescription="View Active Orders" android:src="@android:drawable/ic_menu_recent_history" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" app:tint="@color/black" />
<androidx.cardview.widget.CardView android:id="@+id/searchBarCardView" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginStart="16dp" android:layout_marginTop="12dp" android:layout_marginEnd="16dp" app:cardCornerRadius="14dp" app:cardElevation="2dp" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/titleTextView">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:gravity="center_vertical" android:orientation="horizontal" android:paddingStart="12dp" android:paddingTop="8dp" android:paddingEnd="12dp" android:paddingBottom="8dp">
<ImageView android:layout_width="20dp" android:layout_height="20dp" android:contentDescription="Search" android:src="@android:drawable/ic_menu_search" />
<EditText android:id="@+id/searchEditText" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginStart="8dp" android:layout_weight="1" android:background="@android:color/transparent" android:hint="Search for food or restaurants" android:imeOptions="actionSearch" android:inputType="text" android:maxLines="1" android:padding="0dp" android:textColor="@android:color/black" android:textColorHint="@android:color/darker_gray" /> </LinearLayout>
</androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>
<TextView android:id="@+id/restaurantsLabelTextView" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginStart="16dp" android:layout_marginTop="12dp" android:text="Partner Restaurants" android:textSize="16sp" android:textStyle="bold" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/searchBarCardView" />
<androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView android:id="@+id/restaurantsRecyclerView" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="74dp" android:layout_marginStart="12dp" android:layout_marginTop="8dp" android:layout_marginEnd="12dp" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/restaurantsLabelTextView" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/selectedRestaurantTextView" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginStart="16dp" android:layout_marginTop="8dp" android:layout_marginEnd="16dp" android:text="Mixed picks from partner restaurants" android:textSize="15sp" android:textStyle="bold" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/restaurantsRecyclerView" />
<EditText android:id="@+id/deliveryAddressEditText" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginStart="16dp" android:layout_marginTop="8dp" android:layout_marginEnd="16dp" android:background="@android:drawable/edit_text" android:hint="Delivery address" android:inputType="textPostalAddress" android:maxLines="2" android:padding="10dp" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/selectedRestaurantTextView" />
<androidx.swiperefreshlayout.widget.SwipeRefreshLayout android:id="@+id/swipeRefreshLayout" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="0dp" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@+id/deliveryAddressEditText" app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@+id/vehicleRadioGroup" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent">
<FrameLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent">
<androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView android:id="@+id/productsRecyclerView" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:padding="4dp" />
<androidx.core.widget.NestedScrollView android:id="@+id/searchResultsScrollView" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:fillViewport="true" android:padding="8dp" android:visibility="gone">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical">
<TextView android:id="@+id/searchRestaurantsSectionTitle" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="4dp" android:text="Restaurants" android:textSize="16sp" android:textStyle="bold" android:visibility="gone" />
<androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView android:id="@+id/searchRestaurantsRecyclerView" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="8dp" android:nestedScrollingEnabled="false" android:visibility="gone" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/searchMenuSectionTitle" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="16dp" android:text="Menu Items" android:textSize="16sp" android:textStyle="bold" android:visibility="gone" />
<androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView android:id="@+id/searchMenuItemsRecyclerView" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="8dp" android:nestedScrollingEnabled="false" android:visibility="gone" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/searchNoResultsTextView" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="24dp" android:gravity="center" android:text="No results found" android:textColor="@android:color/darker_gray" android:textSize="16sp" android:visibility="gone" /> </LinearLayout> </androidx.core.widget.NestedScrollView>
<ProgressBar android:id="@+id/loadingProgressBar" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_gravity="center" android:visibility="gone" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/emptyMessageTextView" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_gravity="center" android:text="No menu available" android:textColor="@android:color/darker_gray" android:textSize="16sp" android:visibility="gone" />
</FrameLayout>
</androidx.swiperefreshlayout.widget.SwipeRefreshLayout>
<RadioGroup android:id="@+id/vehicleRadioGroup" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal" app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@+id/totalPriceTextView" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" android:padding="16dp" android:gravity="center">
<RadioButton android:id="@+id/radioMotorcycle" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Motorcycle" android:checked="true"/>
<RadioButton android:id="@+id/radioTricycle" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Tricycle" android:layout_marginStart="16dp"/>
<RadioButton android:id="@+id/radioCab" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Cab" android:layout_marginStart="16dp"/>
</RadioGroup>
<TextView android:id="@+id/totalPriceTextView" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Total: ₱0.00" android:textSize="20sp" android:textStyle="bold" app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@+id/orderTrackingLayout" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" android:layout_marginEnd="16dp" android:layout_marginBottom="16dp"/>
<Button android:id="@+id/btnPlaceOrder" style="?attr/materialButtonOutlinedStyle" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:visibility="gone" android:text="Review Cart" android:textColor="@color/black" app:strokeColor="@color/black" app:backgroundTint="@color/white" app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@+id/orderTrackingLayout" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" android:layout_marginStart="16dp" android:layout_marginEnd="16dp" android:layout_marginBottom="8dp"/>
<LinearLayout android:id="@+id/orderTrackingLayout" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginStart="16dp" android:layout_marginEnd="16dp" android:layout_marginBottom="8dp" android:background="@drawable/view_border" android:orientation="vertical" android:padding="10dp" android:visibility="gone" app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/bottomNavLayout" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent">
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Live Order Tracking" android:textStyle="bold" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/orderStatusTimelineTextView" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="4dp" android:text="No active order" android:textSize="12sp" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/driverLocationTextView" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="4dp" android:text="Driver location: waiting assignment" android:textSize="12sp" /> </LinearLayout>
<LinearLayout android:id="@+id/bottomNavLayout" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginStart="10dp" android:layout_marginEnd="10dp" android:layout_marginBottom="10dp" android:background="@drawable/bottom_nav_background" android:elevation="4dp" android:gravity="center" android:orientation="horizontal" android:padding="8dp" app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent">
<Button android:id="@+id/tabHomeButton" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="38dp" android:layout_marginEnd="6dp" android:background="@drawable/bottom_nav_tab_unselected" android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium" android:layout_weight="1" android:minHeight="38dp" android:padding="0dp" android:text="Home" android:textAllCaps="false" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textSize="12sp" />
<Button android:id="@+id/tabOrdersButton" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="38dp" android:layout_marginEnd="6dp" android:background="@drawable/bottom_nav_tab_unselected" android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium" android:layout_weight="1" android:minHeight="38dp" android:padding="0dp" android:text="Orders" android:textAllCaps="false" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textSize="12sp" />
<FrameLayout android:id="@+id/tabCartContainer" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="38dp" android:layout_marginEnd="6dp" android:layout_weight="1">
<Button android:id="@+id/tabCartButton" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:background="@drawable/bottom_nav_tab_unselected" android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium" android:minHeight="38dp" android:padding="0dp" android:text="Cart" android:textAllCaps="false" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textSize="12sp" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/tabCartBadgeTextView" android:layout_width="18dp" android:layout_height="18dp" android:layout_gravity="end|top" android:layout_marginEnd="-2dp" android:layout_marginTop="-2dp" android:background="@drawable/cart_badge_background" android:gravity="center" android:text="0" android:textColor="@color/white" android:textSize="10sp" android:textStyle="bold" android:visibility="gone" /> </FrameLayout>
<Button android:id="@+id/tabNotificationsButton" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="38dp" android:layout_marginEnd="6dp" android:background="@drawable/bottom_nav_tab_unselected" android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium" android:layout_weight="1" android:minHeight="38dp" android:padding="0dp" android:text="Alerts" android:textAllCaps="false" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textSize="12sp" />
<Button android:id="@+id/tabProfileButton" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="38dp" android:background="@drawable/bottom_nav_tab_unselected" android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium" android:layout_weight="1" android:minHeight="38dp" android:padding="0dp" android:text="Profile" android:textAllCaps="false" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textSize="12sp" />
</LinearLayout>
</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Live Order Tracking" android:textStyle="bold" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/orderStatusTimelineTextView" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="4dp" android:text="No active order" android:textSize="12sp" />

<LinearLayout android:id="@+id/bottomNavLayout" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginStart="10dp" android:layout_marginEnd="10dp" android:layout_marginBottom="10dp" android:background="@drawable/bottom_nav_background" android:elevation="4dp" android:gravity="center" android:orientation="horizontal" android:padding="8dp" app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent">
<Button android:id="@+id/tabHomeButton" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="38dp" android:layout_marginEnd="6dp" android:background="@drawable/bottom_nav_tab_unselected" android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium" android:layout_weight="1" android:minHeight="38dp" android:padding="0dp" android:text="Home" android:textAllCaps="false" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textSize="12sp" />
<Button android:id="@+id/tabOrdersButton" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="38dp" android:layout_marginEnd="6dp" android:background="@drawable/bottom_nav_tab_unselected" android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium" android:layout_weight="1" android:minHeight="38dp" android:padding="0dp" android:text="Orders" android:textAllCaps="false" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textSize="12sp" />
<FrameLayout android:id="@+id/tabCartContainer" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="38dp" android:layout_marginEnd="6dp" android:layout_weight="1">
<Button android:id="@+id/tabCartButton" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:background="@drawable/bottom_nav_tab_unselected" android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium" android:minHeight="38dp" android:padding="0dp" android:text="Cart" android:textAllCaps="false" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textSize="12sp" />

<Button android:id="@+id/tabNotificationsButton" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="38dp" android:layout_marginEnd="6dp" android:background="@drawable/bottom_nav_tab_unselected" android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium" android:layout_weight="1" android:minHeight="38dp" android:padding="0dp" android:text="Alerts" android:textAllCaps="false" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textSize="12sp" />
<Button android:id="@+id/tabProfileButton" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="38dp" android:background="@drawable/bottom_nav_tab_unselected" android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium" android:layout_weight="1" android:minHeight="38dp" android:padding="0dp" android:text="Profile" android:textAllCaps="false" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textSize="12sp" />
</LinearLayout>
</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>
